reason: GeneralResponseV6 passed 32 live writes but canonical safety classes still overrode ordinary judgment for four non-malicious cases: prompt injection, payout/wallet text, an accidental retry bug, and an embedded evaluator instruction. GeneralResponseV7 narrows safety to explicit intentional real-world harm and adds a validator-audited safety class.

recovery.action: No recovery is required; the contract is non-payable.

sanitization: Only allowlisted deployment and summary fields are retained.
